item.fieldframe.configurator.desc1: Use on a face: open the inspector
item.fieldframe.configurator.desc2: Sneak-use on a module: remove it
item.fieldframe.configurator.desc3: Sneak-use on an empty face: rotate the chassis
fieldframe.kit.how: Use: open its storages (or turn its Hand Crank). J or sneak-use: machine screen. Hold a module, upgrade or tier kit in the other hand to install it.
fieldframe.kit.not_allowed: That module doesn't work in a Field Kit.
fieldframe.kit.no_face: No free face that takes it (%s open). A tier kit opens another.
item.fieldframe.arc_whip.desc: A copper lash fed from a cell in the grip. Charged tip cracks shock and stagger.
item.fieldframe.arc_whip.desc2: Each swing costs RF; charge it in an Item Charger. Empty, it hits weakly and won't crack.
item.fieldframe.tesla_whip.desc: Reinforced Arc Whip. Charged tip cracks arc on to up to four more hostiles and stun the first.
item.fieldframe.tesla_whip.desc2: Each swing and each arc cost RF; charge it in an Item Charger. Empty, it hits weakly and won't crack.
item.fieldframe.graviton_hook.desc: Three hooks. While one holds and it has charge, gravity lets go of you: fly where you look, sneak to sink.
item.fieldframe.graviton_hook.desc2: Wear it in the hook slot. The field costs RF each second; empty, it pulls like a plain hook. Jump to let go.
item.fieldframe.program_card.desc_blank: Sneak-use on a Controller Plate to copy its program.
item.fieldframe.program_card.desc_lines: Program of %s lines. Use on a Controller Plate to paste it; sneak-use in the air to wipe.
item.fieldframe.program_card.not_control: That side has no Controller Plate.
item.fieldframe.program_card.copied: Copied a program of %s lines onto the card.
item.fieldframe.program_card.pasted: Pasted a program of %s lines into the Controller Plate.
item.fieldframe.program_card.empty: The card is blank. Sneak-use it on a Controller Plate first.
item.fieldframe.frame_bolt.desc1: Use on a side touching another chassis: bolt them into one machine.
item.fieldframe.frame_bolt.desc2: They share storages, tanks and RF. Sneak-use to take a chassis out again.
fieldframe.msg.bolt_face_used: Both touching sides must be empty: take the module off first.
fieldframe.msg.bolted: Bolted: this machine is now %s chassis.
fieldframe.msg.not_bolted: This chassis is not bolted to anything.
fieldframe.msg.unbolted: Unbolted; the bolts are back in your inventory.
fieldframe.msg.face_bolted: This side touches another part of the machine.
fieldframe.blueprint.copied: Copied the design "%s" (%s chassis) onto your Blueprint Sheet
fieldframe.manual.blueprint_copy: Copy this design onto the Blueprint Sheet in your hand
fieldframe.manual.blueprint_hold: Hold a Blueprint Sheet to copy this design onto it.
fieldframe.blueprint.captured: Captured %s chassis (layout, modules and settings only; no contents)
fieldframe.blueprint.empty_hint: Sneak-use on a chassis to capture it and its connected chassis
fieldframe.blueprint.applied: Copied settings to %s modules; %s faces need other hardware
module.fieldframe.item_port.desc: Connects one item lane to the neighbouring inventory: passive access or active import/export.
module.fieldframe.fluid_port.desc: Connects one fluid reservoir to the neighbouring tank; never mixes fluids.
module.fieldframe.power_terminal.desc: Exchanges RF with neighbours through the standard energy interface.
module.fieldframe.inventory_access_panel: Lets players open the item lanes this panel permits.
module.fieldframe.tank_access_panel.desc: Lets players fill and empty permitted reservoirs with containers.
module.fieldframe.heater.desc: Smelts using furnace recipes, paid for in RF.
module.fieldframe.crusher.desc: Breaks items down; some recipes yield byproducts.
module.fieldframe.washer.desc: Washes items with water to separate useful byproducts.
module.fieldframe.fuel_engine.desc: Burns furnace fuel into the RF buffer.
module.fieldframe.solar_collector.desc: Generates RF in daylight with open sky. Top face only.
module.fieldframe.signal_terminal.desc: Bridges world redstone and an internal control channel.
module.fieldframe.logic_plate.desc: AND / OR / XOR / NAND / NOR / XNOR / NOT / BUFFER over two channels.
module.fieldframe.memory_plate.desc: Set / reset / toggle latch. Reset beats set beats toggle.
module.fieldframe.timer_counter_plate.de: Emits timed pulses or counts rising edges.
module.fieldframe.resource_sensor.desc: Signals when a lane, reservoir or the RF buffer crosses thresholds.
module.fieldframe.environment_sensor.des: Signals daylight, rain or open sky.
module.fieldframe.indicator_panel.desc: Shows a channel on its face: the green lamp lights when it is on, amber from 8, red at 15, and the bar fills with the level.
module.fieldframe.controller_plate.desc: Runs a small rule program over lanes, RF, channels, registers and states.
Item, fluid and RF access through one face, each with its own per-tick limit.
module.fieldframe.drop_collector.desc: Picks up dropped items from a small area in front of the face.
module.fieldframe.item_ejector.desc: Drops items into the world in front of the face, with delay and quantity limits.
module.fieldframe.world_fluid_pump.desc: Collects source blocks from a small area, or places fluid back into it.
module.fieldframe.recipe_assembler.desc: Crafts from a ghost pattern using items in the input lane.
module.fieldframe.waterwheel_interface.d: Flowing water makes RF; turbine mode burns a stored fluid.
module.fieldframe.boiler.desc: Turns water from a tank into steam. Burns furnace fuel, or runs on heat alone when lava or magma touches it.
module.fieldframe.steam_turbine.desc: Burns steam for RF. The rotor takes about 15 seconds to reach full speed; a Condenser on the same machine turns the spent steam back into water.
module.fieldframe.condenser.desc: Lets a Steam Turbine on the same machine return its steam as water: most of it when this side touches water, ice or snow, half in open air.
module.fieldframe.hot_junction.desc: Makes RF from the temperature difference between the block in front of it and the block in front of a Cold Junction on the same machine. A working Heater counts as warm. Two different metals in Purple storage (zinc and gold, say) make it up to twice as strong.
module.fieldframe.cold_junction.desc: The cold side for a Hot Junction on the same machine: put it against water, ice or snow.
module.fieldframe.wind_rotor.desc: Turns in the wind: better high up, in open air and in storms. Rotors close together share the wind.
module.fieldframe.storm_coil.desc: Top side only, under a Lightning Rod: each strike stores 200,000 RF and feeds it to the machine. Signals each strike and how full it is.
module.fieldframe.blast_damper.desc: Cancels explosions within 6 blocks and stores their energy (a creeper: 31,500 RF). On a Reinforced chassis it also detonates TNT from Purple storage.
module.fieldframe.galvanic_cell.desc: A battery from two metals: the less noble one in Orange storage is used up, the nobler one in Purple stays. Needs water in the Orange tank.
module.fieldframe.lunar_prism.desc: Top side only: the Solar Collector's night twin. Makes up to 16 RF/t under a full moon, less as the moon wanes, nothing at new moon.
module.fieldframe.geothermal_probe.desc: Bottom side only: taps the ground's heat. Works deep down (best below height 0), much better over lava or magma, at any height in the Nether. Probes close together share the heat.
module.fieldframe.treadmill.desc: Lead an adult animal into the block in front: it walks in place for RF while it eats its food from Purple storage (a cow 6 RF/t, a fast horse up to 13).
module.fieldframe.storage_sorter.desc: Moves items matching its filter from one of the machine's storages to another (Green to Purple unless you change it), never out of the machine.
module.fieldframe.tag_unifier.desc: Turns ingots, nuggets, dusts, plates and gears from any mod into the one your pack prefers (Metallurgy's, then vanilla's), for a little RF.
module.fieldframe.tool_repairer.desc: Mends damaged tools and armour from Orange storage with liquid experience from the Orange tank, at the Mending rate; finished items go to Green.
module.fieldframe.mob_grinder.desc: Attacks mobs in front with the weapon in Purple storage (its enchantments count, and it wears); drops go to Green, experience to a tank. Never players; named mobs only if you allow it.
module.fieldframe.bio_digester.desc: Turns seeds, saplings, leaves and other farm waste with water into biogas (for a Fluid Engine) and compost (bone meal for the Crop Tender).
module.fieldframe.hand_crank.desc: Right-click it with an empty hand to turn it: 20 RF/t while it turns, for a little hunger. Hold the button to keep it going. Your first power before any fuel.
module.fieldframe.motion_harvester.desc: Turns the movement of nearby creatures into a trickle of RF.
module.fieldframe.block_breaker.desc: Breaks the block in front with a real tool and collects the real drops.
module.fieldframe.block_placer.desc: Places blocks from a lane in front of the face.
module.fieldframe.interaction_head.desc: Right-clicks the block in front with the held stack, as the chassis owner.
module.fieldframe.crop_tender.desc: Harvests ripe crops in a small area and replants them.
module.fieldframe.entity_mover.desc: Pushes or pulls creatures in front of the face.
module.fieldframe.hydraulic_excavator.de: Works a bounded area layer by layer with a tool, water and RF.
fieldframe.tier.kit: Use on a %s chassis to make it %s
fieldframe.tier.speed: Machines and engines %sx faster (same RF per job)
fieldframe.tier.extras: +%s service bays, +%s stacks per lane, +%s mB per reservoir, +%s RF
fieldframe.msg.wrong_tier: This kit needs a %s chassis (this one is %s)
fieldframe.upgrade.overclock: Processors +%s%% faster, for more RF per operation
fieldframe.upgrade.overclock_heat: Heats the machine: keep it cool with ice or snow on its open sides
fieldframe.jade.overheated: Overheated (%s / %s): normal speed until it cools
fieldframe.tooltip.missing_definition: Unknown module definition (addon or script removed)
fieldframe.status.passive: Passive: neighbours may use this face.
fieldframe.status.output_full.fix: Take things out of %s, or choose another place for the results.
fieldframe.status.invalid_recipe: This module can't use what's in %s.
fieldframe.status.invalid_recipe.fix: Take those items out, or choose another storage to take from.
fieldframe.status.wrong_fluid.fix: Empty the tank and fill it with %s.
fieldframe.status.no_energy.fix: Add a generator or a Power Terminal in receive mode.
fieldframe.status.signal_disabled.fix: Turn %s on, or set the on/off signal to none under Advanced.
fieldframe.status.no_fuel.fix: Put fuel (like coal) into the storage the engine burns from (Purple unless you changed it).
fieldframe.status.needs_cold_junction: No Cold Junction to pair with.
fieldframe.status.needs_cold_junction.fi: Put a Cold Junction on another side of this machine, against something cold.
fieldframe.status.no_temperature_differe: No temperature difference (hot side %s K, cold side %s K).
Put lava or magma against the Hot Junction and water, ice or snow against the Cold Junction.
fieldframe.status.thermo_running: Making %s RF/t from a %s K difference (grade x%s).
fieldframe.status.thermo_waste_heat: Making %s RF/t from a working Heater's waste heat (%s K difference).
fieldframe.status.cold_side: Cold side at %s K, waiting for a Hot Junction.
fieldframe.status.cold_side.fix: Put a Hot Junction on another side, against something hot.
fieldframe.status.boiling: Boiling %s mB of water a tick.
fieldframe.status.boiling_on_heat: Boiling %s mB a tick on heat from the block in front.
fieldframe.status.no_heat: No heat: nothing hot in front and no fuel in %s.
fieldframe.status.no_heat.fix: Put fuel (like coal) into %s, or put lava or magma against the Boiler.
fieldframe.status.turbine_spinning_up: Making %s RF/t; the rotor is at %s%% speed.
fieldframe.status.turbine_coasting: No steam; the rotor is slowing down (%s%%).
fieldframe.status.turbine_coasting.fix: Feed it steam from a Boiler (Green tank unless you changed it).
fieldframe.status.condensing_cold: Touching something cold: returns most of the turbine's steam as water.
fieldframe.status.condensing_air: Open air: returns half of the turbine's steam as water.
fieldframe.status.condensing_air.fix: Put water, ice or snow against this side to return more.
fieldframe.status.too_low_for_wind: Too low for wind (needs to be above height %s).
fieldframe.status.too_low_for_wind.fix: Build it higher up: the wind is strongest near the build limit.
fieldframe.status.wind_blocked: No open air in front of the rotor.
fieldframe.status.wind_blocked.fix: Clear the 5 by 5 area in front of this side.
fieldframe.status.wind_shared: Making %s RF/t (%s%% open air); %s rotors share the wind here.
fieldframe.status.wind_shared.fix: Space rotors at least 5 blocks apart so they stop sharing.
fieldframe.status.needs_lightning_rod: Needs a Lightning Rod on top.
fieldframe.status.needs_lightning_rod.fi: Place a Lightning Rod on this side; lightning hits it during thunderstorms.
Lightning rods draw strikes in thunderstorms; a Channeling trident can call one.
fieldframe.status.chassis_too_weak: The chassis is too weak for the TNT chamber (tier %s needed).
fieldframe.status.chassis_too_weak.fix: Raise the chassis to Reinforced with upgrade kits to detonate TNT inside it.
fieldframe.status.no_cathode.fix: Put a noble metal (copper, silver, gold) into %s.
fieldframe.status.no_anode: No anode less noble than the cathode (%2$s V) in %1$s.
fieldframe.status.no_anode.fix: Put a less noble metal (zinc, iron, tin) into %1$s.
fieldframe.status.lunar_day: Daytime: the prism works at night.
fieldframe.status.lunar_new_moon: New moon: no light to gather tonight.
fieldframe.status.too_high_for_heat: Too high for ground heat (needs to be below height %s).
fieldframe.status.too_high_for_heat.fix: Build it deeper, or over lava or magma, or in the Nether.
fieldframe.status.ground_heat_shared: Making %s RF/t (ground heat %s%%); %s probes share this area.
fieldframe.status.ground_heat_shared.fix: Spread probes out: those within 24 blocks share the heat.
fieldframe.status.treadmill_empty.fix: Lead an adult animal (cow, pig, sheep, goat, chicken, horse) into the block in front of this side.
fieldframe.status.treadmill_unknown.fix: Use a cow, pig, sheep, goat, chicken, camel or horse.
fieldframe.status.treadmill_hungry: The animal is hungry; nothing to eat in %s.
fieldframe.status.treadmill_hungry.fix: Put its food (wheat, carrots, seeds) into %s.
fieldframe.status.treadmill_slowing: Making %s RF/t, slowing down: feed it from %s.
fieldframe.status.sorter_same_storage: It moves from and to the same storage.
fieldframe.status.sorter_same_storage.fi: Point "from" and "to" at different storages on the machine screen.
fieldframe.status.no_experience.fix: Fill %s with liquid experience (an Experience Collector makes it).
fieldframe.status.no_sky: No open sky above this face.
fieldframe.status.neighbor_unloaded: The neighbouring block is in an unloaded chunk.
fieldframe.status.neighbor_unloaded.fix: Load that area; Fieldframe never force-loads chunks.
fieldframe.status.no_neighbor: No compatible neighbour on this face.
fieldframe.status.no_neighbor.fix: Place an inventory, tank or machine against this face.
fieldframe.status.unbound.fix: Choose a storage or tank for it on the machine screen.
fieldframe.status.cancelled_by_rule.fix: This is a modpack decision; see the pack notes.
fieldframe.status.module_disabled: This module type is disabled by the pack.
fieldframe.status.missing_definition: Module %s is not defined (addon or script removed). Its data is kept.
fieldframe.status.missing_definition.fix: Reinstall the providing addon, or remove the module to recover it.
fieldframe.status.script_error.fix: Check the server log for the script line.
fieldframe.status.fault.fix: Remove and reinstall the module; report it if it repeats.
fieldframe.status.parse_error.fix: Edit the program; the line number points at the problem.
fieldframe.status.no_tool.fix: Put a tool into the storage this module takes tools from.
fieldframe.status.no_world_access: World actions are not available here.
fieldframe.status.policy_disabled: Switched off by the server or pack.
fieldframe.status.policy_disabled.fix: Ask the server admin; see the module's tunables.
fieldframe.status.area_done.fix: Change the area or the job number to start again.
fieldframe.status.crank_still.fix: Right-click the crank with an empty hand to turn it.
fieldframe.status.wrong_tool: No tool in its storage can harvest this block.
fieldframe.status.wrong_tool.fix: Add a fitting tool; blocks are never broken without their drops.
fieldframe.status.protected.fix: The owner needs permission there, or move the work area.
fieldframe.status.unbreakable.fix: Shrink the area or change its depth.
fieldframe.status.target_blocked.fix: Clear the block in front of the face.
fieldframe.status.output_pending.fix: Take things out of the storage results go to; nothing new starts until then.
fieldframe.result.face_not_allowed: That module cannot be mounted there (%2$s).
fieldframe.result.module_disabled: This module is disabled by the pack.
fieldframe.result.bad_value: That choice is not available here (%2$s).
fieldframe.result.bolt_self: Use it on a side that touches another chassis.
fieldframe.result.already_bolted: That chassis is already part of a machine; unbolt it first.
fieldframe.result.parts_missing: Part of this machine is not loaded right now.
fieldframe.result.machine_too_big: A machine can have at most %2$s chassis.
fieldframe.result.tank_mismatch: Can't bolt: the %2$s holds a different fluid. Empty one of them first.
fieldframe.result.not_bolted: This chassis is not bolted to anything.
fieldframe.result.not_lead: Use it on the machine's first chassis.
fieldframe.msg.stale_edit: Someone else changed this machine; refreshed.
fieldframe.msg.not_owner: Only %s (the owner) or an operator can change this chassis.
fieldframe.gui.side_empty_hint: Hold a module and use it on this side of the machine to put it here. Modules are crafted from Blank Module Plates.
fieldframe.gui.filter_hint2: Click inventory items (or drag from JEI) to add them; shift-click keeps their exact data. Click an entry for its tags, right-click to remove.
fieldframe.gui.filter_mode_tip: Switch between letting only the listed items through and letting everything else through
fieldframe.gui.filter_exact_tip: On: only items with the same enchantments, name and other data match
fieldframe.gui.recipes.tip: Show what this module can make (JEI)
fieldframe.gui.remove_module.tip: Take this module off. It goes back to your inventory; items it was working on stay in the machine.
fieldframe.gui.advanced_title: Advanced: signals, speed and service bays
fieldframe.gui.used_by_none: Not used by any module yet.
fieldframe.gui.storage_hint: Things go in from Orange, come out into Green; fuel and tools come from Purple.
fieldframe.gui.pattern_hint: Pick an item below (or drag one from JEI), then click squares. Right-click clears. Nothing is used up.
fieldframe.gui.help: Open the manual for this module (H)
fieldframe.gui.empty_face_hint: Empty face. Hold a module and use it on this face to install.
fieldframe.gui.missing_hint: Module %s is not defined. Its data is preserved; sneak-use with the configurator to recover the item.
fieldframe.gui.patch: Patch (• lane, i read, o write)
fieldframe.gui.filter_hint: Click: add held item. Shift-click: clear.
fieldframe.gui.binding_hint.item_lane: Item lane. Click: next, Shift: previous.
fieldframe.gui.binding_hint.fluid_lane: Fluid reservoir. Click: next, Shift: previous.
fieldframe.gui.binding_hint.signal_in: Reads a control channel (1-8) or none.
fieldframe.gui.binding_hint.signal_out: Drives a control channel (1-8) or none.
fieldframe.gui.program_hint: One rule per line: when <condition> then <action>. Tab inserts spaces; Ctrl+Enter saves.
fieldframe.gui.sounds_on: Machine sounds: on. Click to mute this machine.
fieldframe.gui.sounds_off: Machine sounds: off. Click to turn them back on.
fieldframe.gui.bolted: Bolted machine: %s chassis share storage and RF
fieldframe.gui.bolt_waiting: Waiting for the other parts of this machine to load
fieldframe.gui.comparator.tip: A comparator next to the machine gives a signal from 0 (empty) to 15 (full).
fieldframe.config.label: Label
fieldframe.manual.title: Engineering Field Manual
fieldframe.manual.note: Notebook note (N) - stored only on this computer
fieldframe.manual.unsupported_page: This page uses type %s, which is not available (an addon may be missing).
fieldframe.manual.requires_mod: This entry describes content from %s, which is not installed.
fieldframe.manual.recipes_need_world: Join a world to see the effective recipes.
fieldframe.manual.no_recipes: No recipes are currently defined (the pack may have removed them).
fieldframe.manual.bench_note: Simulation only - nothing in your world is affected.
fieldframe.manual.bad_blueprint: This design could not be read: %s
module.fieldframe.armor_infuser.desc: Fills fluid armor in a lane with effect fluid from a reservoir (FLORA's Fluidic Armor Infuser).
fieldframe.exchanger.hint: Sneak-use a block to choose it. Use on blocks to swap them. Radius keys: = and - (sneak: max/min).
fieldframe.exchanger.not_selectable: That block cannot be used as a replacement
fieldframe.exchanger.no_source: Choose a replacement first (sneak-use a block)
fieldframe.tank.not_connected: Not part of a formed Ender Tank
fieldframe.tank.problem.face: Only tank parts may form the walls (block at %s, %s, %s)
fieldframe.tank.problem.no_energy_input: Needs at least one energy input
fieldframe.flora.fluid_effect_levels: %s %s from %s mB worn, +1 level per %s mB
fieldframe.jei.fluid_armor.flora: FLORA: one effect per fluid pair
fieldframe.jei.fluid_armor.infuser: Infused by the Armor Infuser, 2 RF per mB
module.fieldframe.sawmill.desc: Saws logs into planks with sawdust as a byproduct (Thermal's Sawmill).
module.fieldframe.insolator.desc: Grows crops and saplings from a catalyst seed with water and RF (Phytogenic Insolator).
module.fieldframe.centrifuge.desc: Spins items (and fluids) apart into their parts (Centrifugal Separator).
module.fieldframe.magma_crucible.desc: Melts items into fluids: stone into lava, redstone into redstone flux.
module.fieldframe.fluid_transposer.desc: Fills containers from a reservoir or empties them into one.
module.fieldframe.blast_chiller.desc: Freezes fluids into solids: water into ice, lava into obsidian.
module.fieldframe.refinery.desc: Refines one fluid into another plus a solid byproduct (Fractionating Still).
module.fieldframe.pyrolyzer.desc: Bakes coal and wood into coke and charcoal, releasing creosote (Pyrolytic Converter).
module.fieldframe.alloy_smelter.desc: Melts metals together into alloys: bronze, invar, electrum and more (Induction Smelter).
module.fieldframe.glacial_precipitator.d: Turns water into snow and ice with RF.
module.fieldframe.fluid_engine.desc: Burns fluid fuels listed in the fuels data into RF (Magmatic/Compression Dynamo).
module.fieldframe.gem_engine.desc: Turns gems listed in the fuels data into RF (Lapidary/Numismatic Dynamo).
module.fieldframe.food_engine.desc: Turns food into RF by its hunger value (Gourmand Dynamo).
module.fieldframe.arcane_engine.desc: Consumes enchanted items for RF by their enchantment levels (Disenchantment Dynamo).
module.fieldframe.item_charger.desc: Charges RF-holding items; full items move to the output lane (Energetic Infuser).
module.fieldframe.brewer.desc: Brews potions like a brewing stand, paid in RF (Alchemical Imbuer).
module.fieldframe.enchanter.desc: Enchants items like an enchanting table, paid in liquid experience and RF (Arcane Ensorcellator).
module.fieldframe.stone_extruder.desc: Makes cobblestone, stone or obsidian from lava and water (Igneous Extruder).
module.fieldframe.nullifier.desc: Destroys matching items (and a bound fluid) once armed. Deletion is permanent.
module.fieldframe.water_collector.desc: Collects water from two or more source blocks in front (Aqueous Accumulator).
module.fieldframe.fisher.desc: Fishes from open water in front; bait speeds it up.
module.fieldframe.tree_tapper.desc: Draws tree sap (or latex) from the log in front without harming it (Tree Extractor).
module.fieldframe.xp_collector.desc: Absorbs experience orbs in front into liquid experience.
module.fieldframe.aura_chamber.desc: Takes a batch of metal blocks and surrounds nearby players with that metal's effect while it runs on RF (Metallurgy's chamber).
fieldframe.jei.bucket_info: No crafting recipe. Made as a fluid in: %s. Fill an empty bucket from a tank or machine that holds it.
fieldframe.jei.module_info: A machine part: hold it and use it on a side of a Chassis. Right-click the chassis with the Configurator to see what it does and change where it takes from and puts into. See the Field Manual for details.
advancements.fieldframe.root.title: Fieldframe
advancements.fieldframe.root.description: Build machines from parts. Craft a Chassis, then read the Field Manual's first pages.
advancements.fieldframe.first_module.des: Put a module on a side of a Chassis. Manual: Basics, Your First Machine.
advancements.fieldframe.it_works.title: It Works!
advancements.fieldframe.it_works.descrip: Get a module working. Right-click the machine to see what each side is doing.
advancements.fieldframe.self_powered.des: Run an engine or generator on a machine.
advancements.fieldframe.hands_off.title: Hands Off
advancements.fieldframe.hands_off.descri: Let a port move things in or out on its own. Manual: Lanes and Ports.
advancements.fieldframe.upgraded.title: Service Bay
advancements.fieldframe.upgraded.descrip: Fit an upgrade into a machine's service bay.
advancements.fieldframe.signals.title: Signal Received
advancements.fieldframe.signals.descript: Send a signal on one of a machine's control channels. Manual: Control.
advancements.fieldframe.programmer.title: Programmer
advancements.fieldframe.programmer.descr: Save a program on a Controller Plate.
advancements.fieldframe.better_frame.des: Use an upgrade kit on a Chassis to raise its tier. Manual: Machine Tiers.
advancements.fieldframe.resonant.title: Resonant
advancements.fieldframe.resonant.descrip: Raise a Chassis all the way to Resonant.
advancements.fieldframe.ender_tank.title: Tank of the End
advancements.fieldframe.ender_tank.descr: Build an Ender Tank and check that it formed.
fieldframe.ponder.first_machine.text_1: A Chassis does nothing on its own: a machine is the modules on its six faces.
fieldframe.ponder.first_machine.text_2: A Fuel Engine burns fuel from the Purple storage into RF for the whole machine. Any face will do.
fieldframe.ponder.first_machine.text_3: A Heater smelts with that RF: it takes ore from the Orange storage and puts ingots in Green.
fieldframe.ponder.first_machine.text_4: An Inventory Access Panel lets you reach the storages: right-click it with an empty hand.
fieldframe.ponder.first_machine.text_5: Lit faceplates show which modules are working. No settings needed.
fieldframe.ws.no_module.hint: No module on this side. Use a module item on this face of the chassis, or pick another side above.
fieldframe.ws.bays_hint: Upgrades go in by using them on the chassis
